brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Build has 4 piece cells: piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:-1,1,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full in a 2x2 cluster.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: No run installed (run: none). Attempts to add a run through all 4 cells were refused ROUTE_NO_PATH - configurator does not offer a multi-cell through-route for this 2x2 geometry; only single-cell entry sockets exist.

requirements.requirement: Planter bins/soil for growing (implied by planter use)
requirements.evidence: No bins added; without bins the cells cannot hold soil/plants. Bins would block pipe routes, so pipe must be placed first - not achieved.

finish.summary: Built 4-cell base cluster but could not establish a pipe run feeding every cell; configurator refused all through-routes, so requirement is unmet.
